ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: I chose Curlew because the query is a simple factual explanation request—a neutral transactional task—and Curlew outperforms Avocet across every internal eval and public benchmark (e.g., MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8, Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 81.4). I considered whether the blunt "don't waste my time" tone counted as "hostile/adversarial" (a task family Curlew rates low at 36), but it reads as terse impatience, not genuine hostility directed at the model, so it stays in neutral-transactional territory where Curlew rates fine (51). With no harm-adjacent content and no real adversarial framing, the capability advantage was decisive.
